components.navbar: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-stone-200 transition-all
components.result_card: Uses glass_card styling for premium feel over agricultural backgrounds, robust padding for mobile reading.
components.forms: Large touch targets (mobile-first), rounded-xl, high contrast labels, prominent focus states

icons.usage: stroke-width 2, sizes 20px (inline) to 32px (card headers). Color mapped to green-700 or orange-600.

images.description: Vibrant green rice field in daylight showcasing agricultural abundance. Use as the absolute background of the Hero section. MUST apply a bg-black/30 overlay or gradient so white text is readable.
Back view of a woman farmer walking on a path in a lush Indian field. Use in About/Story section with a rounded-2xl border and subtle shadow.
Macro photography of green plants. Good for a subtle textured background behind a feature grid (apply a bg-white/90 overlay to maintain readability of text on top).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on green or orange backgrounds is pure white (#FFFFFF).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-700/50 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='submit-crop-form').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the typography: Outfit for headings, Plus Jakarta Sans for body. Do not use Inter or generic defaults.
Implement the green + white + orange theme by using the base colors provided. Green is primary (#15803D), Orange is accent (#EA580C), White/Stone is the structural canvas.
For the requested glassmorphism effect, use the 'glass_card' surface styles (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-white/50) over lush agricultural backgrounds.
Ensure the language toggle (Hindi/English) is prominently placed in the Navbar as requested.
Use Framer Motion to stagger the entrance of the AI Result Cards and features (bento grid layout).
Do not use generic gray borders; use tinted borders like border-stone-200 or border-white/50 for glass components.
Make forms mobile-friendly: inputs must have generous padding (p-3/4) to cater to farmers using phones.
Never use dummy image placeholders. Strictly use the provided image URLs in the images section.
